ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-29-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Maureen Howard.
Petitioners: Jose Luis Rios Hernandez and Mariana Santiago Galaviz, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem forthe Minor: Amaury Omar Vazquez Santiago, and with Spanish Interpreter: Noemi Sanchez Molina.
Petitioners and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Amaury Omar Rios Santiago.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-15-2007 Reset To May-29-07 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, VJ: Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, Not reported.
Petitioners: Jose Luis Rios Hernandez and Mariana Santiago Galaviz, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Amaury Omar Santiago.
Without a Interpreter, matter is continued to May 29, 2007 at 9:00 A.M. in Dept. 218, for Petitioner to bring own Interpreter.
The Court waived re-publication of the OSC.
